title: Align govspend publish shape and review follow-up
reason: Maintainer review asked whether the PR used the printing-press-publish process. This patch records the follow-up that added publish metadata, tightened Grants.gov edge cases, and prepared the PR body for the publish template.
validated_outcome: Publish-package verifier passes for library/other/govspend, publish validate passes, Grants.gov empty keywords are omitted from request payloads, and doctor --live now reports Grants.gov application-level errors returned inside HTTP 200 responses.
